question: If the mode of a data exceeds its mean by 77.7, then the mode exceeds the median by _____. (Use empirical formula to find the answer)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Empirical formula ⇒ Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean

Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean)

Given = 77.7 ⇒ Median − Mean = 77.7 ÷ 3 = 25.9

Mode − Median = 2 × 25.9 = 51.8

**∴ Answer = 51.8**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode − Mean = 77.7

**Formula used:**

Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mode − Mean = 3 Median − 2 Mean − Mean

⇒ = 3 Median − 3 Mean

⇒ = 3(Median − Mean)

⇒ 77.7 = 3(Median − Mean)

⇒ Median − Mean = 25.9

⇒ Mode − Median = (3 Median − 2 Mean) − Median

⇒ = 2 Median − 2 Mean

⇒ = 2(Median − Mean)

⇒ = 2 × 25.9 = 51.8

**∴ The correct answer is 51.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relation

Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean

Derived Relation

Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean)

Quick Trick

Mode − Median = 2/3 × (Mode − Mean)
